svg.title: CDSCO-IndiaAI Full System Architecture
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing portal ingestion, AI processing pipeline, four core modules, compliance layer, and output delivery for the CDSCO-IndiaAI Health Innovation Hackathon solution.

g.text: Normalise all input formats before AI processing
Async message bus — Apache Kafka / RabbitMQ
Decouples pipeline stages; guarantees delivery and retry
Each module is independently deployable as a microservice
Coordinates module calls, context passing, and fallback logic
All AI decisions validated against regulatory frameworks
Results surfaced to CDSCO reviewers and portal users

svg.text: Infrastructure — FastAPI microservices · Docker / Kubernetes · CI/CD GitHub Actions · Nginx reverse proxy
Security — JWT auth · TLS 1.3 · row-level encryption · RBAC · VAPT tested before deployment
Observability — Prometheus · Grafana · ELK stack · Sentry error tracking · model performance dashboards
